detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A xianxia inspired cultivation game where you rise from a mere mortal to an immortal cultivator.

Features:

  • Cultivate your body, mind, and soul

  • Experience tribulations and breakthrough realms

  • Uncover and learn powerful techniques

  • Gather materials, refine pills, and forge legendary equipment

  • Explore dungeons and fortuitous encounters

  • Fight powerful monsters and other cultivators

  • And many more..!

The path of immortality never ends!
